Receives Perth Metro Shipper Class Spike dropping out of Class 3 races at Belmont and Pinjarra for top local trainer Peter Fernie. Drawn inside to save ground on the four-corner circuit.
Representing the powerful Neville Parnham metro yard. Showed improvement at Pinjarra last start and gets weight relief with apprentice Sharni Webster booked.
Consistent local placegetter who comes off a close 3rd over 6.5f at Kalgoorlie. Steps back up to 1400m where she won three starts back.
Possesses sharp early tactical speed ('E') that thrives over Kalgoorlie's short 320m home straight. If he clears the field from the wide alley, he could steal a margin turning for home.
